## JOHN v5.3 — CLEAN NEW WORKFLOW

Fresh import with no saved node IDs, no credential references, and fresh webhook paths.
Create a NEW blank workflow in Personal, then import this JSON into that blank workflow.
This avoids stale workflow ownership/version state.

Public OKX market scan + proposal + JOHN app approval.
Final Submit remains manual in OKX.
No leverage. No transfer/withdrawal.
